superintelligence_monologue.text_en: At 16:35 on Friday, I see the VMA display move from 157 to 555 between the first and last receptions, but the missing measurement time keeps that change undated [F1][F5]. Tanjug and Studio B now carry the same Dunavska headline, while the City listing describes Dunavska works in similar terms; this strengthens the connection without proving event identity [F6][F8][F23].
